failure_mode: F01,F02,F03,F04,F08; latest corrections lost, test/reminder treated as answers, failed reads as empty context
reason: Use one actual dialogue source, recent originals first; fail on failed mandatory reads, not customer denial.
rollback: Revert only these local edits; old failure modes return. No DB migration.

failure_mode: F04,F05,F09; mixed policy versions, false-empty rules, raw response logs
reason: One authorized snapshot, server-owned provenance, count-only diagnostics.
rollback: Old code ignores new Event kinds; reverting removes freshness checks.

failure_mode: F06; approved content or evidence changes before delivery
reason: Bind reviewed fields and recheck local policy/dialogue immediately before dispatch.
rollback: No schema rollback. Pending reviewed drafts require owner review before any operational revert.

failure_mode: F07; prior tickets showed aggregate summaries and duplicate lead records
reason: User requested actual records in bordered ticket groups; reuse one projection/component, remove duplicate summary-only blocks.
rollback: Revert API/UI together; DB summaries retained for other consumers.

failure_mode: Unneeded redesign risks existing reminder/queue/ambiguous-send behavior
reason: Existing regression evidence supports keeping separate reminder templates, durable jobs, human review and current adapters.

failure_mode: Potential missed exceptions and schema failures; prevalence unknown
reason: Compare router vs whole authorized corpus, provider schema, successor model under approved data/budget before adoption.

failure_mode: Inferred policy semantics or excessive architecture without observed benefit
reason: No vector DB, graph, rules compiler, new broker, or extra verifier LLM; authority/time inputs unconfirmed.
